specNotes: OpenRTB 2.6 §3.2.6 Object:Banner / §4.3.3 Object:Bid — a bid answering a banner-only impression is expected to deliver banner markup; a VAST video document cannot be displayed as a banner and provides no playable video slot either, so it is not a valid fill for this impression under any reading.

video-web-25-inline-vast2 supplies the reused, independently-valid VAST 2.0 document — its own base pair passes VAST-internal validation cleanly, isolating this case to the banner/VAST content-type question rather than to unrelated VAST well-formedness findings.
